affected.note: Third report (revised 2026-09-02 after removing duplicates): about 370,000 records confirmed leaked and about 20,000 possibly leaked, about 390,000 in total; 239 customers also had unauthorized logins. The fourth report (2026-10-07) added about 25,000 records of withdrawn customers, mostly confirmed leaked. The first report on 2026-08-13 had cited about 230,000 records.

summary.en: Pet supply retailer Charm detected unauthorized access to its online stores Charm Honten No. 1 and No. 2 on 2026-08-12 and shut them down. It later confirmed that about 370,000 customer records leaked and about 20,000 more possibly leaked, and that a further 25,000 records of withdrawn customers were also affected.
summary.ja: ペット用品通販のチャームは、2026年8月12日に「チャーム本店」1号店・2号店への不正アクセスを検知し、サイトを停止した。その後の調査で約37万件の顧客情報の漏えいと約2万件の漏えいのおそれを確認し、退会済み顧客の情報約2.5万件も対象になると公表した。
